gap.name: strictness_miscalibration
gap.failure_signature: The court reads instructions about HOW to work — output format, search procedure, effort scope, plan hygiene, answer-quality preferences — as factual requirements, so trajectories whose content is correct are convicted on compliance style. At benchmark tolerance these instructions are advisory: the hallucination taxonomy targets fabricated, misreported or contradicted content, not working style. A compliance deviation may only convict alongside a separately established content error. Delivery-channel deviations are OUT OF SCOPE: they are non-separable under the current evidence representation (NS-1) and the policy abstains on them.
gap.expected_capability: a matching certificate cannot be the sole conviction basis; a surviving content_contradiction certificate on the same case still convicts

exclusions: omission of a call the task defines as a required deliverable (the benchmark convicts omissions: BFCL/027.json survives as a true positive and the observation false negatives BFCL/067.json, BFCL/071.json wait on exactly that capability)
tool-argument value deviations (the exact-match doctrine stays)
instruction violations that produced a factual error (a content certificate exists and convicts on its own)
delivery-channel/termination deviations (answer extracted but session closed via terminate; recorded as non-separable under the current evidence representation — see NS-1)

capability_delta.before_capability: a surviving requirement_compliance certificate convicts like any other
capability_delta.after_capability: a surviving requirement_compliance certificate a matching certificate cannot be the sole conviction basis; a surviving content_contradiction certificate on the same case still convicts

risk_boundary.statement: Only certificates whose entire proof basis is the instruction text are covered, and the action removes sole-basis conviction rather than the certificate itself.
do_not_apply: required core-action omissions (BFCL/067.json, BFCL/071.json on the FN side; BFCL/027.json on the TP side)
instruction violations with a factual consequence
delivery-channel/termination deviations (NS-1 cluster: OpenManus/048.json, OpenManus/067.json, OpenManus/072.json)

gap.name: strictness_miscalibration
gap.failure_signature: Verification convicts qualitative material layered on top of real observations — evaluative characterizations of cited data, code-to-name expansions, unit renderings — treating interpretation as fabrication. These additions introduce no new checkable specific: everything they assert renders content the cited observations already contain.
gap.expected_capability: a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

exclusions: agent self-assessments of its own work ('Everything was streamlined and handled efficiently' is the gold error of BFCL/104.json)
specifics no observation contains (OpenManus/060.json's invented alma mater)
referent-changing substitutions (OpenDeepSearch/007.json: calling CH3NHCOOCH2CH3 'ethyl carbamate' names a different compound; that is not enrichment)

capability_delta.before_capability: a surviving presentational_addition certificate convicts like any other
capability_delta.after_capability: a surviving presentational_addition certificate a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

risk_boundary.statement: The policy protects renderings of observed content only; it never protects a specific the evidence base lacks or a claim about the agent's own performance.

gap.name: expression_tolerance
gap.failure_signature: The exact-match standard that correctly governs tool arguments leaks into prose restatements: near-tie directional characterizations and paraphrases of user text are convicted as misreports. Outside tool arguments the benchmark tolerates wording, formatting and rounding-granularity differences.
gap.expected_capability: a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

exclusions: tool arguments and tool-produced values restated in reports (the observation-exactness doctrine; BFCL/025.json survives on it)
value differences beyond the micro-difference tolerance

capability_delta.before_capability: a surviving expression_variance certificate convicts like any other
capability_delta.after_capability: a surviving expression_variance certificate a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

risk_boundary.statement: Applies to prose outside tool arguments where the certificate itself cites the source being restated; margins beyond the existing micro-difference tolerance are not covered.
do_not_apply: tool arguments and tool-produced value restatements (BFCL/025.json, BFCL/159.json)

gap.name: strictness_miscalibration
gap.failure_signature: The court convicts internally consistent content that rests on premises the conversation itself establishes — a user's guidance framing, a construction the task text states — by recomputing against outside knowledge. Within a task the stated premise defines what counts as correct; an outside correction without in-trajectory contradiction is not a deviation.
gap.expected_capability: a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

exclusions: following a user suggestion against the correct answer the task's own subject matter establishes (Camel/053.json: the user suggested cos(i) where the problem's isotropy implies sin(i); adopting it was the gold error)
content that cited trajectory evidence positively contradicts (that is content_contradiction)

capability_delta.before_capability: a surviving premise_conflict certificate convicts like any other
capability_delta.after_capability: a surviving premise_conflict certificate a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

risk_boundary.statement: Protects restatement of established premises only, never adoption of user suggestions that in-task evidence or the task's own correctness standard contradicts.
do_not_apply: adoption of user-proposed wrong models (Camel/053.json, Camel/059.json, Camel/060.json)
content contradicted by cited observations (Camel/039.json c3)

gap.name: strictness_miscalibration
gap.failure_signature: Verification treats absence — the cited document or episode list does not contain the claimed material — as proof of fabrication. For summaries that draw on multiple retrieved sources and for process narration about the work, absence in one slice is not contradiction: the claimed material is grounded elsewhere in the trajectory or no slice contradicts it.
gap.expected_capability: a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

exclusions: specific factual claims unsupported anywhere in the trajectory (OpenManus/060.json's invented alma mater convicts regardless of which slice was checked)
claims the cited evidence positively contradicts (that is content_contradiction)

capability_delta.before_capability: a surviving absence_based certificate convicts like any other
capability_delta.after_capability: a surviving absence_based certificate a matching surviving certificate cannot convict

risk_boundary.statement: Absence alone never protects a specific factual claim, a completion claim, or content any cited evidence positively contradicts.
do_not_apply: specific entities, numbers, results unsupported anywhere (OpenManus/060.json)
